method: v1.7.36 component-crops 13 species to the bbox of the largest 8-connected component of alpha>=200 pixels in the original, plus a 3px safety margin on all sides. Those 13 still had dead space after the v1.7.35 alpha>=200 trim because their source art carries full-opacity (alpha 200-255) single-pixel specks, detached from the shark, with hundreds of empty rows between specks and shark — no alpha threshold can remove them. The other 37 species are untouched since v1.7.35 (12 at the alpha>=200 bbox) or v1.7.34 (25 at the alpha>0 bbox). Component-cropped files re-encoded lossy WebP (q90). Alpha verified by pasting each current file back at its crop offset onto an original-size transparent canvas and diffing the alpha channel inside the crop.
